name: Photo2VR
summary:
Turn ordinary photos into 3D images for viewing in VR on Meta Quest.

Photo2VR converts your 2D photos into Side-by-Side (SBS) 3D images and saves the results to your Quest photo library. Select one photo or convert several at once, with progress shown for every image.

The built-in photo viewer is free to use and does not require conversion credits. View your own 2D photos and SBS 3D images, or try the six included 3D demo photos immediately.
